review: Detector draft in this image's pixels. Reliable: window, sill, cornice, molding, balcony, blind; arch and round window shapes, pediments (cornice tri over an opening, else k pediment) and finials come from a model trained on monuments: keep them where the photo agrees. Check yourself: door (weakest class), shop, pillar, deco, set h; px is the box around the detected elements: move it to the facade's own corners (the wall's edges and the roofline usually lie a little outside it; drop neighbours' windows), merge duplicates, add rustic/quoin. palette: colours read off the photo (median, exposure-corrected); check it before passing it on.
